reference_prompt: Create one polished game-asset concept reference for a single collectible fantasy potion bottle for Tetherbound, a warm stylized creature-adventure RPG. This will be the image-to-3D reference for Meshy, so show exactly ONE complete upright bottle, isolated on a plain light gray background, full object including bottom, centered, three-quarter front view with front nearly square to camera. No grid, no other views, no text, no symbols, no ingredients, no pedestal, no detached parts. Design: a squat rounded hexagonal glass vessel with gently bulging sides and smoothly curved shoulders, narrow short neck, a fitted natural cork stopper, an aged warm brass rolled lip and small protective brass heel ring. Bottle body is opaque-looking hand-painted desaturated sea-green glass with rich but restrained tonal variation, a deeper teal lower body, softly luminous-looking turquoise edges rendered by paint and lighting rather than actual glow or transparency; no see-through background, no bloom. Around the lower-middle body is a beautifully fitted dark brown leather band with subtle edge stitching, a shallow circular warm-brass badge bezel integrated tightly into the FRONT of the band; the bezel's circular center is blank dark leather, ready for a different stat emblem to be added in 3D later. Badge occupies approximately one third of body width, not a billboard. Craftsmanship: curved and softened edges, fine controlled cork grain, restrained leather grain, slight brass patina, appealing sturdy handmade proportions, readable large forms, excellent material separation. Art style: high-quality hand-painted stylized PBR fantasy prop, polished enough to sit beside detailed adventure characters, not low-poly primitive/blockout, not photorealistic and not toy plastic. Soft studio key from upper left and gentle fill show surface shape without harsh glossy white streaks. Bottle should feel like a memorable usable adventurer's item. Do not add red, skulls, wings, spikes, runes or words.
